**Quick‑check list for a Redis timeout in staging**

| # | What to look at | Why it matters | How to verify |
|---|-----------------|----------------|---------------|
| 1 | **`REDIS_URL` in the staging environment** | The client will only connect if the URL is correct. A typo, wrong host, or wrong port will cause a timeout. | `docker compose exec api env | grep REDIS_URL` (or `printenv REDIS_URL` inside the container). Compare with the value you use locally. |
| 2 | **DNS / hostname resolution** | Staging containers often run in a different network; the host name in the URL may not resolve. | `docker compose exec api ping -c 1 cache.internal.orbital.example` or `nslookup cache.internal.orbital.example`. |
| 3 | **Network reachability / firewall** | Even if the host resolves, a firewall or security group may block port 6379. | `docker compose exec api nc -vz cache.internal.orbital.example 6379` (or `telnet`). |
